title: Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage, Nov 23, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Atlassian, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Potential reach is broad among developers: Bitbucket and Atlassian sign-in are widely used by software teams. Atlassian lists only a partial outage, and it had run about an hour at last check. It has not said how many customers were hit.
who_is_affected: Developers and teams who sign in through Atlassian's OAuth service or run Bitbucket Pipelines, from 10:19 AM ET on Monday, Nov 23. The incident was still open at our last check.

known.text: Atlassian's Bitbucket status page opened an incident at 10:19 AM ET on Nov 23 for failing OAuth token requests, and it was still open at 11:12 AM ET.
The incident lists Authentication and user management and Pipelines as partial outages; the Bitbucket website, API and Git access show operational.
Atlassian says it has identified the cause and is working on a mitigation. It has not said what the cause is.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. Atlassian has not said.
Whether it was an attack. No one has claimed one and Atlassian has not addressed it.
